eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 3rd International Conference on Computational Intelligence Approaches and Applications (ICCIAA)
eventDetail.about: Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems
eventDetail.sponsors: Jordan Section; Petra University; Universiti Teknologi MARA - UiTM
eventDetail.keywords: Computational Intelligence,Artificial Intelligence,Data Mining,Big Data,Data Science,
eventDetail.scope: We welcome submissions on computational intelligence, including (1) AI & Knowledge Systems: expert systems, reasoning, hybrid AI, and applications in healthcare, finance, education, and smart cities; (2) Machine Learning: predictive modeling, deep learning, and data-driven decision-making in marketing, recommendations, anomaly detection, etc.; (3) Vision & NLP: image, speech, and text processing, with uses in autonomous systems and medical imaging; (4) Big Data & Cloud: IoT, intelligent infrastructure, real-time analytics, and predictive maintenance; (5) Evolutionary Computing: algorithms, swarm intelligence, autonomous systems, and optimization; (6) AI for Cybersecurity: threat detection, secure AI, and privacy-preserving learning.
